entries.title: Gas-Phase Molecules Forming from Colliding Atoms
entries.description: A box of differently colored atomic spheres floats and jitters randomly, colliding and snapping into rotating diatomic and triatomic molecules with short glowing bonds and labels that appear when formation thresholds are met.
entries.seed: Gas-Phase Molecules Forming from Colliding Atoms: A box of differently colored atomic spheres floats and jitters randomly, colliding and snapping into rotating diatomic and triatomic molecules with short glowing bonds and labels that appear when formation thresholds are met.

entries.title: Crystallization from a Supersaturated Molecular Solution
entries.description: A transparent box of slowly drifting solute molecules shows them attaching to a central seed crystal lattice, where they align, lock in place, and cause the growing crystal to extend in a grid pattern with subtle color changes and a “crystal size” meter.
entries.seed: Crystallization from a Supersaturated Molecular Solution: A transparent box of slowly drifting solute molecules shows them attaching to a central seed crystal lattice, where they align, lock in place, and cause the growing crystal to extend in a grid pattern with subtle color changes and a “crystal size” meter.

entries.title: Water Molecule Formation from Hydrogen and Oxygen Clouds
entries.description: Red (O) and white (H) atoms drift inside a light-blue box, and when two H atoms collide with one O at the right angle they attach into bent H₂O molecules that wobble, rotate, and leave faint blue trails while unreacted atoms keep bouncing.

entries.title: Polymer Chain Growth from Monomer Units
entries.description: Single monomer spheres with directional “bond sites” float in a region and, upon contact, snap together to form long flexible chains that wiggle, coil, and occasionally branch, with chain length displayed as a dynamic label above each polymer.
entries.seed: Polymer Chain Growth from Monomer Units: Single monomer spheres with directional “bond sites” float in a region and, upon contact, snap together to form long flexible chains that wiggle, coil, and occasionally branch, with chain length displayed as a dynamic label above each polymer.

entries.title: Protein Folding from a Linear Amino Acid Chain
entries.description: A colored bead chain representing amino acids starts stretched out, then gradually bends, rotates, and snaps into specific contact points as “hydrophobic” beads cluster inward and “hydrophilic” beads face the water-like environment, with temporary dashed bonds highlighting new interactions.

entries.title: Molecular Orbital Overlap Visualization
entries.description: Two semi-transparent electron cloud blobs (s, p orbitals) approach each other; as they overlap, combined orbitals form with changing shapes and brightness, while small labeled nuclei spheres maintain fixed positions and the overlap region pulses to show bond strength.
entries.seed: Molecular Orbital Overlap Visualization: Two semi-transparent electron cloud blobs (s, p orbitals) approach each other; as they overlap, combined orbitals form with changing shapes and brightness, while small labeled nuclei spheres maintain fixed positions and the overlap region pulses to show bond strength.

entries.title: DNA Double Helix Formation from Nucleotide Pairs
entries.description: Individual nucleotide “rungs” (color-coded A–T, C–G) float in space then align and snap between two sugar-phosphate backbones, which twist around each other to form a rotating double helix, with base pairs briefly glowing as they correctly match.

entries.title: Molecular Clustering into Micelles
entries.description: Amphiphilic molecules with hydrophilic heads and hydrophobic tails drift in a watery box; over time they spontaneously cluster so heads face outward and tails tuck inside, forming spherical micelles that gently pulse, move, and occasionally merge.

entries.title: Ionic Lattice Formation from Positive and Negative Ions
entries.description: Red (+) and blue (–) charged spheres wander in a transparent cube, attracting and snapping into a growing alternating 3D lattice that stays fixed at the center, with electric field lines faintly drawn between ions and a running count of lattice layers.

entries.title: Nanotube Growth from Carbon Atoms
entries.description: Free carbon atoms bounce around a light background and attach to a seed ring, gradually building a cylindrical carbon nanotube that grows upward, with each new hexagonal ring briefly highlighted and the tube gently rotating to show its structure.

entries.title: Molecule Formation in an Expanding Universe Box
entries.description: In a box whose edges slowly move outward, hot fast-moving atoms cool over time (speed decreases, color shifts from red to blue) and begin forming simple molecules when they collide, with newly formed molecules leaving short-lived glowing trails.

entries.title: Catalyst Surface-Assisted Molecule Assembly
entries.description: A flat, stationary catalyst plate sits in the center while gas-phase atoms and small molecules drift above it; when they land on specific catalyst sites they move along the surface, meet, and combine into products that then detach and fly off with a brief pulse of light.

entries.description: Inside a large transparent cell sphere, small metabolites diffuse and occasionally enter enzyme “stations” where they are converted and joined into larger molecules; products glow softly and travel along faintly marked pathways to different cell regions.

entries.description: A loosely packed cluster of atoms starts as a random blob; over time, atoms reposition via rotations and small hops, shedding extra atoms and settling into a compact, symmetric molecule shape that spins slowly, with rejected atoms drifting away.
